difficultyNote: Editorial assessment with the four choices visible; not measured player solve rates.
curation: Exclude elementary openings and mismatched decoys. Each question has three individually chosen incorrect choices. One of each subject per shuffled eight-question block; independent fresh-match shuffle.
compatibility: Keep all legacy question IDs resolvable for active matches; only admitted IDs enter fresh games.
sourceChecks: New factual prompts checked against the linked reference contents; word puzzles additionally verified mechanically. Existing factual prompts retain prior source lineage.

newQuestions.subject: Gaming
newQuestions.prompt: You try to sleep in a bed in Minecraft’s Nether. What happens?
newQuestions.explanation: Beds explode in the Nether; they do not work there as Overworld spawn points.

newQuestions.subject: Gaming
newQuestions.prompt: In Majora’s Mask, how long is the repeating cycle before the moon falls?
newQuestions.explanation: Link works inside a repeating three-day cycle, resetting time to keep going.

newQuestions.subject: Gaming
newQuestions.prompt: In Mario Kart 8, your coin-based speed increase tops out at how many held coins?
newQuestions.explanation: Held coins increase speed up to the ten-coin cap; getting hit can knock coins away.

newQuestions.subject: Gaming
newQuestions.prompt: In Mario Kart 8’s antigravity sections, bumping another racer can actually give you what?
newQuestions.explanation: Antigravity changes collisions: contact can give you a Spin Boost instead of simply slowing you down.

newQuestions.subject: Sports
newQuestions.prompt: An NBA shot hits the rim and the same team gets the rebound. What does its shot clock reset to?
newQuestions.explanation: An offensive rebound after a rim-touching missed shot resets the clock to 14, not a fresh 24.

newQuestions.subject: Sports
newQuestions.prompt: A legal soccer throw-in goes straight into the opponents’ goal without touching anyone. What is awarded?
newQuestions.explanation: A throw-in cannot score directly. Into the opponents’ goal means a goal kick; into your own means a corner.

newQuestions.subject: Sports
newQuestions.prompt: A baseball fly ball hits the foul pole above the outfield fence. What is the ruling?
newQuestions.explanation: Despite the name, the foul pole is in fair territory.

newQuestions.subject: Sports
newQuestions.prompt: You trail 0–40 in a standard tennis game, then win the next three points. Where are you now?
newQuestions.explanation: Three points bring you to 40 too. At 40–40 the game is at deuce, not over.

newQuestions.subject: Screen
newQuestions.prompt: Who is the intimidating food critic whose review matters in Ratatouille?
newQuestions.explanation: Anton Ego is the critic. Gusteau is Remy’s inspiration; Skinner runs the kitchen; Django is Remy’s father.

newQuestions.subject: Screen
newQuestions.prompt: Which of these Inside Out 2 emotions was already in Headquarters in the first film?
newQuestions.explanation: Disgust belongs to the original five. Envy, Ennui and Embarrassment arrive in the sequel.

newQuestions.subject: Screen
newQuestions.prompt: Toy Story 3’s villain Lotso is a scented teddy bear. What does he smell like?
newQuestions.explanation: Lotso’s sweet strawberry scent makes a very misleading first impression.

newQuestions.subject: Screen
newQuestions.prompt: Which Pixar character turns out to be a mother despite a traditionally male name?
newQuestions.explanation: Kevin is female. Russell’s choice of name does not change that.

newQuestions.subject: Music
newQuestions.prompt: Which collaboration brought J. Cole his first Grammy win in 2020?
newQuestions.explanation: The 2020 Best Rap Song award went to “a lot.” The other choices are also real Cole collaborations.

newQuestions.subject: Music
newQuestions.prompt: Whose lead vocals do you hear on Daft Punk’s Get Lucky?
newQuestions.explanation: Pharrell supplies the lead vocal; Nile Rodgers supplies the distinctive guitar part.

newQuestions.subject: Music
newQuestions.prompt: Whitney Houston made I Will Always Love You a huge hit. Who originally wrote and recorded it?
newQuestions.explanation: Dolly released her own version in 1974, long before Houston’s recording for The Bodyguard.

newQuestions.subject: Music
newQuestions.prompt: Before fronting Foo Fighters, who played drums on Nirvana’s Nevermind?
newQuestions.explanation: Nevermind’s lineup includes Kurt Cobain, Krist Novoselic and drummer Dave Grohl.

newQuestions.subject: World
newQuestions.prompt: By longitude, which US state contains both the country’s easternmost and westernmost points?
newQuestions.explanation: The Aleutian Islands cross the 180th meridian, putting parts of Alaska in both east and west longitudes.

newQuestions.subject: World
newQuestions.prompt: Everest leads above sea level. Which mountain exceeds it when measured from its base on the ocean floor?
newQuestions.explanation: Much of Mauna Kea is underwater. Base-to-summit height and elevation above sea level are different measurements.

newQuestions.subject: World
newQuestions.prompt: How do the Panama Canal’s locks lift a ship toward Gatun Lake?
newQuestions.answer: Raise the water level around the ship
newQuestions.explanation: Water enters the lock chamber and the floating ship rises with it. The locks are water lifts.

newQuestions.subject: World
newQuestions.prompt: Which of these landmarks was built first?
newQuestions.explanation: The Great Pyramid belongs to ancient Egypt’s Old Kingdom, thousands of years before the other three.

newQuestions.subject: Nature
newQuestions.prompt: Octopus blood can look blue because its oxygen-carrying protein uses which metal?
newQuestions.explanation: Octopuses use copper-based hemocyanin; human hemoglobin uses iron.

newQuestions.subject: Nature
newQuestions.prompt: Botanically speaking, which of these fruits is a true berry?
newQuestions.explanation: Botanical categories do not follow supermarket names: a banana counts as a berry.

newQuestions.subject: Nature
newQuestions.prompt: Sharks have teeth, but their skeletons are built mainly from what instead of bone?
newQuestions.explanation: Cartilage is also the flexible tissue in your nose and ears.

newQuestions.subject: Nature
newQuestions.prompt: Why does the sky look black from the Moon even when the ground is in daylight?
newQuestions.answer: Almost no air to scatter sunlight
newQuestions.explanation: Earth’s atmosphere scatters light across the sky. The Moon’s extremely thin atmosphere cannot create that blue sky.

newQuestions.subject: Everyday
newQuestions.prompt: Why can baking powder raise a cake batter without adding sour milk or lemon juice?
newQuestions.explanation: Baking powder combines bicarbonate with an acid; moisture lets them react and release carbon dioxide.

newQuestions.subject: Everyday
newQuestions.prompt: Which cocoa ingredient does real white chocolate contain?
newQuestions.explanation: White chocolate contains cocoa butter, but not the nonfat cocoa solids that give dark chocolate its color.

newQuestions.subject: Everyday
newQuestions.prompt: Despite its name, the nutmeg you grate into food is which part of a plant?
newQuestions.explanation: Nutmeg is a seed. A familiar kitchen name can be misleading about the plant part.

newQuestions.subject: Everyday
newQuestions.prompt: Which milk component binds capsaicin, helping explain milk’s effect after spicy food?
newQuestions.explanation: Casein is a milk protein that binds capsaicin, the compound responsible for chili-pepper heat.

newQuestions.subject: Words
newQuestions.prompt: In Greek mythology, what is Atlas condemned to hold up?
newQuestions.explanation: Atlas supports the heavens. The globe image often causes people to misremember his burden.

newQuestions.subject: Words
newQuestions.prompt: Which word contains THREE consecutive doubled-letter pairs?
newQuestions.explanation: B–OO–KK–EE–P–E–R: the three consecutive pairs are OO, KK and EE.

newQuestions.subject: Words
newQuestions.prompt: Which phrase uses every letter of SCHOOLMASTER exactly once?
newQuestions.explanation: Ignore the space: SCHOOLMASTER and THE CLASSROOM have exactly the same letters, including their counts.

newQuestions.subject: Words
newQuestions.prompt: In standard English Scrabble, playing all seven of your tiles in one turn adds what bonus?
newQuestions.explanation: Using all seven tiles in one turn adds 50 points on top of the word score.
